title: Chemistry · Paper 1 (SL) — original full-format practice

instructions: Complete the selected-response and data/working questions under one timer. An approved calculator is required. Use the original reference data supplied within this sample; no external data booklet is needed. Enter each answer beside its question; no separate answer sheet is used.
